t:
, you see, the update came out today, but it got set up wrong – the Mender Robots have gone nuts now!

They holed up in the server room – we can't even get inside, have to chase them off with a broomstick... but that's just a temporary solution!

So we need to sort this out decisively. You break them down completely, and we'll get new ones under warranty – right?
When a Mender Robot gets broken, it's alright, but when an assembly engine does, it's a damn nightmare!
Are the cyberbeetles dealt with? Swell, I'll then send someone else to pick up all the gears and file for a refund...
The bar with drinks and food is to the left, the gaming capsules are to the right, but there's no exit! Haha!
You work off the ticket – you can go wherever you feel like!

h: And how do I work it off?

t: Well done! Come around again if you feel like – we can hire you, part-time!
Excellent – the cyberbeetles have been dealt with, and another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Find the real owner of the wallet and give the item to him.

, these nerds are so out of their minds that they're losing their items left and right! People've been bringing me all kinds of stuff: Jeb-phones, mechanical penises, collectible cartridges... Now, someone's lost their wallet full of drachmas! It should be returned... the problem is finding who the real owner is.

If you find a way to do that, you get respect from me!
Everyone will say the drachmas are their own!
Ahh, thank you! I can have a few more shots now!
Return the lost wallet to the real owner.

The wallet was found, and the owner was so happy that he could not even be bothered to thank you. The administrator was definitely excited about the "help" you've been giving. Another task has been fulfilled, and we keep on moving to the shining future. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Eliminate 12 members of the Sekhem gang.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Eliminate 12 members of the Kheni gang.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Eliminate 12 members of the Khud gang.

Now, we need to busy ourselves with Khuds – these haughty rich folk who flaunt their wealth as if it's the only thing they have in life.

Reference: "The Khud subculture brings together the Arisen who possess considerable financial resources. Their primary characteristic is seeking luxurious lifestyles, exclusive services and high social status. Khuds are the ones who believe that everything can be bought with money, including respect".

It's a bit odd that they've not yet realized their money don't impress anyone here. So let's make sure they learn that in this city, there are things far more important than their gold watches and posh manamobiles.

Common sense, for instance.

Excellent! The Khuds now know that their "money" aren't going to save them from our "kindness". But don't get relaxed: they're already plotting revenge. And we will keep delving into our Wireframe project in the meantime – it's clearly not going to have less issues now.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Learn the details from Sarang Kido, then gain audience with Negus Shuponu.

! Thus far, I have been unable to contact Nefer Ur. I do not even know where he is now, actually. I suppose we will have to try obtaining this information from the head of the city department – Negus Shuponu... But how do we gain access to him?

As you know, he is a part of a rather different structure that is not directly subordinate to our agency...
So what else is up there?

Our companions can be just about anywhere! I'm even afraid... they might be dead. The portal was unstable, so we ought to be ready for the worst.

As for Nefer Ur, I'll keep trying to contact him, but we must start looking for other methods. Negus Shuponu may well be aware of what is happening.
h: What do we do? Where do we find the others?

t: Find a way to calm down Ahbu the little elephant.
Is the little elephant still rioting?

Have you dealt with the elephant issue? Excellent! If only that had been the only problem we've been having with these robobeasts.

The strongest of them were once the nobility of Hickut, the courtiers of our last ruler. They are worshipping various elements...
Ask music records vendors about Nomarkh Khey and find him.
Well, how goes the search for the most popular singer?
Procure 10 ancient papyrus magazines for Semer Shereda

Why would I need the guys if I have the Thing?..

Ah, the question wasn't for you, ! What do you need?

Hmm... that cartridge... with Pyramids... All right, that'll take some doing! Do you even know that Hickut had a very advanced field of literature on the subject of games? There were so many different magazines, and they are all extremely valued as collectibles now! "Great Dragons", "The Land of Hickut", "Mummy Store", "Pyramid Navigator", "Pharaoh Mania"? I'm collecting items from that period. See, everyone's only reading news on the Jeb-net now.

Get me, say, ten retro magazines printed on papyrus!
Oh, wow... These are real rarities! I'll be sure to read them... Take your cartridge, cheni!
Collect the three games you need.
Oh, that's pretty fast! I wouldn't even dream of trading these games so quickly... You have a real talent for collecting...
Find a record by the SheHer band through trading.
Where's that courier loitering? How much longer do I have to wait?..

Yes, he did come around today, picked a great big box of vinyls. He asked to send them to him by the way of a courier... but the courier's nowhere to be found. Well, why don't we do it like this: I tell you where to find him, and you will deliver the order to him along the way!
h: Have you seen Nomarkh Khey by any chance? Do you know where he is?

t: Hey, music aficionados and fans of the spacey sounds! I have something incredible for you, right here! This is the record by Hypersonic – the real masters of the musical cosmos! Each note is like a rocket launched into unexplored galaxies! If you want to live that feeling of soaring among the stars, you really have to get this record! It is filled with experimental sounds and hypnotic rhythms that will make your ears tremble in delight! Don't miss the chance to become the owner of this masterpiece! The number of copies is limited, and they sell like hot cakes!

The next request has been filed: you need to find ancient gaming magazines... Ah, do you even know that Hickut had a great variety of literature on the subject of games? There were so many different magazines, and they are all extremely valued as collectibles now! "Great Dragons", "The Land of Hickut", "Mummy Store", "Pyramid Navigator", "Pharaoh Mania"?

One of the collectors is now asking you to obtain the missing issues. I guess it's not going to be problematic for you at all...

Oh, magazines... gotta read 'em again now... uh, I mean, gotta pack 'em up and send 'em to the client. Another request fulfilled, and what does that mean? That means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Ask 6 Arisen near the administration about their current problems.
Take a survey of the public opinion, asking 12 citizens of Sar-Iram and recording their replies by using the special device.
Discuss the plan with Sarang Kido.

Now, we will part for a while. I'll try to find out more, and you follow Negus Shuponu's directions. There are many weird things on Xadagan, we're almost besieged, so your talents will be greatly helpful here. When I learn more, I will send a message to you. For now, remember: trust no one!
Eliminate 12 members of the Fegen gang and their leader, Sarang Sekani.

Another gang has appeared! They're real troublemakers and rioters! They are calling themselves the Fegens. A Fegen is... well, it's some kind of trash, or even worse. Actually, their name speaks for itself!

Fegens, and especially their leader – Sarang Sekani – must be dealt with!
If you've managed to deal with the fegens, other gangs will become more cautious... That means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Eliminate Yasskul Flach and 7 Path of Fire Heretics.
These flame-worshippers are out to set the whole allod on fire!
So, at least these ones have been deal with... But while you were away, we had a total electrical blackout here... three times! Something has to be done about this, too...
Eliminate Semer Myum and 12 Path of Fire Heretics.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: We need new artifacts today. Will you be able to find them?
Are you done with the task?
Excellent, these artifacts will be exceedingly useful for the Arisen community of Xadagan. Here's your reward.
Bring 5 artifacts: Kiss of Mother Djut.
Have you succeeded in dealing with them?

The next request has been filed: wild monkeys have taken residence in our district, and they are starting to cause trouble. These restless things not only devastate our stocks, but they may be dangerous to the citizens as well. We need to get rid of the monkeys quickly and efficiently, so that tranquility is returned to the city's vicinity. I am sure you know how that can be done. The most important thing is to act considerately and watch their behavior so that none of them might escape. I entrust this task to you!

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: The next request has been filed: you must find the diary of a little girl who has regretfully perished in the plague, and has not been resurrected. This diary may contain important information on her life and the events of those terrible times. We know it was extremely valuable to her, and the fact that it disappeared is alarming. You will have to explore the places where she might leave it... I am sure you will be able to handle this task! Patience and attention are the keys here.

Here is the diary! I can't believe we've finally found it. It looks like there are many records of her life and thoughts in those dire times. This might well be a real treasure that would help us with understanding her story and the things that were happening around her. We will study each page meticulously – perhaps there is important information here, information that will help us learn more of her and her circle. Meanwhile, we are coming ever closer to the completion of the Wireframe project!

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: What is the purpose of your appeal?
Is your question a personal or an official one?
h: I want to get an appointment with the head of the city department!

t: Activate the permission to purchase food in Xadagan's network by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to purchasing food in Xadagan's network through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Access to "Food and Drinks" service activated!
Activate the permission to purchase mirra in Xadagan's network by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to purchasing Mirra in Xadagan's network through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's postage network by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's auctions by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to Xadagan's auction through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's banking network by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to Xadagan's banking network through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's barber by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to Xadagan's barber through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's barber by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to reincarnations on Xadagan through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Access to "Expert in the Inexplicable" service activated!
Activate the permission to access Xadagan's teleportation network by using a Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Allows access to Xadagan's teleportation network through the nearest Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
Arrive to Negus Jibayd, the chief of the Cosmodrome project, together with agent Sarang Makalani.

So, why are you running late, ? The workday has started long ago! What do you mean, "loose schedule"? You just look and see what's happening here!

If the launch fails, you will be losing your head... literally!

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Help with preparing the launch by completing 4 tasks from Negus Jibayd and his colleagues.

What's going on? You're asking me what's going on?! You just take a look around! These nutcases, the followers of Earth's cult, are all around! The rocket is not filled up with fuel! Control devices are not working, and our brave trailblazers, straight from Isa, have gotten hysterical!

Let's get this sorted out at least, !
The rocket is not ready to take off! I am rescheduling the launch for five more minutes!
Drain the fuel remaining in 8 barrels, then refuel the rocket.
The rocket will not take off by itself!
Drain the fuel remaining in 8 barrels, then refuel the rocket.

Eh, greetings, my deardarling  "Fuel Researcher"

We have a minor, but pretty "hot" issue here.

The rocket is standing still, like a lousy lover on the first date, and waiting to be refueled! We need to collect fuel barrels and fill its tanks, or else our cosmonauts risk ending up stranded here for good, like the pathetic "space tourists" who forgot their tickets at home.

So grab your tools and go looking for these barrels!
Kill 12 of the Path of Earth Heretics

One would think that all of the Arisen are smart, rational beings... But no – there are a few ignoramuses among us... ones that would skip school to attend protest rallies instead!

Path of Earth Heretics – how'd you like that? What do you think they're preaching? Love for the Earth, of course! They believe tthat we're polluting it – fouling the air, tainting the water, contaminating the soil... Well, of course, yes, we do! We mess it up! But how could we avoid it? Everybody needs progress!

And now, these psychos have set out to disrupt the launch! You listen to someone like Yaver Thunberg... Like, the rocket is burning up too much fuel, and Sarnaut's not going to take it, and all the seals on Ferris will go extinct. Well, nobody's proved any of that, but trying to explain that to them is pointless!

Or rather, there's a way of "trying"... but with your own tried-and-true methods, !
They say that the temperature of the Astral has jumped by a whopping 0.85 degrees over the last hundred years!
Let their bodies be made into fertilizer! The biofarm demands new shipments, as if on cue... I think they're going to like it...
Kill Stoneater and 12 of the Path of Earth Heretics.

Well, have you dealt with these eco-fanatics? Excellent! I'm getting ready to analyse their beliefs, but I'm afraid they've had the time to leave behind a manifest of "restoring nature" on the Jeb-net, and soon, there will be more of their followers around. But no one can stop the completion of the Wireframe project!

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Free 6 cosmodrome personnel taken as hostages

It's so hard now to find good personnel! Pure science, after all, is not the most lucrative kind of activity. It's not like dealing in augmentations, you know! The salaries here are not the highest, and it's a hazardous job, too!

But now, something totally unbelievable is happening! These crazies are all around, and now, they decided to take our workers hostage!

Can you set them free, ? I'm sure they'll be grateful! Just be sure to unlock the cages, and the heretics themselves have the keys...
This way, the last of our workers'll run away! We're already laboring overtime!
Well then, looks like you've managed to rescue everyone! And now, back to work! We need to make up for the lost time!
Free 6 cosmodrome personnel taken as hostages

Greetings to you, our heroheroine! We got a wee little problem with the eco-extremists here... These same ones who can ruin our mission like a lame joke would a party! We need to free the hostages – cosmodrome workers seized by these "green" fanatics.

I hope you're not averse to playing "Space Zack" and saving these poor souls?!

So grab your "tool of salvation" and move out – time to show these eco-activists that they can find real trouble not only at the bottom of a garbage dump!

Excellent! Have you freed the hostages? I hope they didn't think of claiming their new "eco-friendly" worldview contracted from their captors?!

We can now continue with our work without undue obstructions. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Deliverance from the green hell" project. I mean, the completion of the Wireframe project.

Ahh... Xadagan was quiet and even boring, they said! Few orcs would be entrusted with setting up instrumentation on a cosmodrome, and now these crazy coots have flushed all of my work right down the stinkhole! All the gear has gone haywire! And that right after we've set everything back up following the hacking from last week!

Alright, we need to fix everything up, pronto! Thankfully, these morons didn't even have enough in them for breaking stuff properly... You gotta knock on the boxes a little, and they start working again... Why wouldn't you do the knocking, , and I see what comes of it!
That's not giving anything yet... Knock some more!
Hey, everything's working again! You're a real smart ladlass there, know just where to knock it... Attaboygirl!

Wonderful! Have you repaired the devices? We can now launch rockets without fear of being stranded here for good.

Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Space Renaissance" project. I mean, the Wireframe project.
Prepare the cosmonauts, Squirrel and Arrow, for the flight.
If they refuse, we'll shove them right in!
They told us it would be exciting, but what we got here is a kind of iron boat...
h: What do they say on Isa?

t: Ugh, I don't want sweets! Go and eat your own candy...
Are you daft or what? You look more like a fur shoe than I do!
Take the vessel with gibberlings into space.
Are you waiting for something? We're also waiting!
Excellent! The Gibberlings are off to spin circles around Sarnaut! We'll launch an Arisen next, and then fly to the Moon!
Launch the spaceship with supplies for the Gibberlings into orbit.

Hey, hey, hey! We are in need of your extraordinary abilities – a rocket must be launched again in order to bring supplies to our cosmonauts. To these same Gibberlings. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!

By the way, I don't understand why some fools are complaining about us "dooming the poor furry critters"? The Gibberlings are alive and kicking, and they will be coming back home soon! What we need now is bringing them food and carrying away that which results from processing said food.

So grab your buttons and launching tools – time to show this rocket who's in charge here!
Arrow... she likes being praised! And Squirrel will be ashamed of fearing the flight!
h: How do I find the right approach to them?

t:
Everyone Lies! Haven't you heard about this, ?

This is really so... Are you ready to learn the truth? The crushing truth that will turn about all of your conception of the events?

I believe the answer is yes...

The cosmodrome is but a cover-up! They are already here!

And who are they? I'll show you. We need to reach the place which is the real reason for all of this to be built... We will have to steal a pass for this... But you will go the whole way for the sake of the truth, won't you?
We are too close to the truth!

Do you understand now? The governments of the League and the Empire have constructed a monstrous conspiracy to conceal the truth! All this time, they were aware of the aliens' existence – and hiding it! We must reveal the truth to the world! We must lead an alien out of here and present the proof of its existence! For many years, I've been working for this moment!
Leave Zone 53 and arrive to Agent Makalani's shelter.

I have a shelter nearby – one that nobody knows about, . I've got an extremely powerful, yet portable, communications device there. From that place, we will be able to present the proof of the aliens' existence to the entire world!

Come on, hurry up, the alarm will be sounded soon!

Looks like no one knows where we are now... Literally just one step remains! We will be able to prove to everyone that the aliens have arrived to Sarnaut a long time ago! That the governments have been aware, for years now, of the other worlds and all that... The truth must be revealed to everyone!
Help Agent Makalani by completing 3 of his tasks.
Uhhhh... An alien? What are you talking about?
Feed the alien by collecting 12 pieces of Scorpion meat

First: our alien must be fed! I don't really think it was well nourished back there, in the secret zone... But for starters, we need to learn... what does it feed on, actually? Oh well – it's not like we have any choice... Let's try scorpion meat, . It sounds like something aliens would eat!
The alien is hungry! But I would object to sharing some of my chips with him!
Excellent – right what we need, but first, we need to tell everyone!

Have you already heard of the new project dedicated to studying Scorpions? Oh yes, these tiny creatures might actually be a source of incredible proteins and other nutrients! I want you to go to the desert and gather Scorpion meat for further study.

Don't forget that they can be aggressive and even a little venomous, but this only adds extra spice to our experiment! After all, who wouldn't love to taste a "pan of crispy scorpions"? I hope you won't forget to bring along a pair of protective gloves and a little Pheromone sauce – what if they're going to end up even more delicious than we believe?

Ah, so you're back with Scorpion meat! Excellent! We can now start analyzing their muscle filaments and learn how they can be used to improve our nutrition. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Conceal the shelter by collecting 10 pieces of wreckage and using them to create a camouflage.

Second: conceal the shelter so that absolutely no one can find it. I saw all kinds of junk scattered around – they're an ideal material for making truly elaborate camouflage! I think it won't be hard for you to come up with something... though being creative is the most important thing, ! Use your imagination!
No one's going to find us now! No one will stop us from exposing the conspiracy!
Collect 12 pieces of wreckage between the station and the cosmodrome.

Greetings to you again! We have a very "exciting" task here: collecting salvage metal and other kinds of recyclables. Sure, I know it sounds like a job for a homeless junkyard-dwelling robot, but believe me: it is important for our project.

We must make sure that we have enough materials for creating something great... or at least for not looking like pathetic bohemians! So grab your gloves and go looking for these "treasures"!

Oh, my! Have you collected the salvage metal? I hope you've not run into anything too sinister! Now we have the material to work with – let's hope that when Mechanoids are assembled from it, they're not going to "rise up" all by their own! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the "Metal Paradise" project. I mean, the Wireframe project.
Set up repeaters by performing a special procedure.

The third, and the most important! Time to inform all of Sarnaut about the aliens! For this, I have an old, but extraordinary powerful broadcast station here – it is capable of transmitting the signal even to other allods! We will show the alien to the world and expose the governments' conspiracy, !
Have you managed to set up the station? Indeed, this is not the easiest thing to do... There ought to be a manual somewhere...
Time to tell the entire world about the alien! Preparing to broadcast!
There's a lot of paper books here, which is not typical of Xadagan
You are about to start the process of setting up the repeater. The manual says that astral interference may appear during the process, and these will have to be eliminated.
h: Press the red and blue buttons at once

t: A repeater device that is slightly out of order is before you.
Learn what happened to Agent Makalani.

I'm not quite following what you are talking about, . An alien? What kind of alien? We have been unable to find evidence of their existence after all. Perhaps if we had been able to infiltrate the secret zone of the Cosmodrome, we would have acquired some information about them...
So what is the conspiracy about?
Why do I always have to clean up after amateurs! Did you think we would really be unable to track you, ?
Talk to Negus Harakhti to learn the whole truth about the aliens.
Thus the Corps ended up classified...

The aliens must not learn of the fact that we've turned against them, . We have managed to procure their vehicles and capture their agents. Unfortunately, we are unable to guarantee that they have not infiltrated the government – they are skilled masters of disguise and mind magic, as well as extraordinary powerful psionicists. The hypno potential is up 5 runes. Anyone can be an alien in disguise!
Return to Negus Shuponu and report on the events.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Arrive to the Integral at the Mana Station's subterranean communications to receive further instructions. Use the information terminal for faster transit.

The Integral is writing to you:

"Thank you for the cooperation, .

Evaluating necessities...

Analysing possibilities...

Issuing tasks...

Goal: analysing subject actions. Subject name – Tep.

Method: receiving additional information.

Approach: receive additional instructions by receiving audio-visual message in immediate vicinity, at least 5 metres.

Urgency: immediate.

Further communication possible following request execution."

Thank you for the cooperation.

Basic information is required to create an efficient communication channel.

Reference: Negus Menes is researching the biography of Tep. The most efficient of all sources of information available at present.
Talk to Negus Menes and complete 4 tasks given by him and his colleagues.

Problem Statement: meet with Negus Menes. Receive data on Tep. Send the data to the information bank for further analysis.

Negus Menes is presumably located at: "Library" complex, otherwise called the Informatorium. The storage place for the entire sum of knowledge possessed by the Arisen.

Execute.

Urgency: immediate.
When am I going to receive the missing data?

Tep's history is the grand labor of my entire, uhh... postlife! I have been gathering any accounts of him, some seemingly insignificant... But now, I am despairing, shattered, devastated! No, my labors will not be completed, for everything is arrayed against me... I am so tired, .
Now I remember it, now I don't – this is the most typical predicament for any of the Arisen.
Excellent – now I need to separate the memories of "Kahoteps", "Minhoteps" and deceased pet cats from truly valuable information! That is going to take some time...

Oh, wonderful! You have collected the information! We are now able to access the most sacred thoughts of Sar-Iram's citizens. I hope you've not been running into too many intimate details – I'm not ready to discuss my impression of their "romantic adventures" with you.

But either way, we are now one step closer to discovering the mysteries of the Plague era! And who knows – maybe these memories are hiding the answer to the question of why our dreams are so strange? Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
If it goes on like this, robots will surely destroy our civilization!

Ah, so have you heard of our Robotic Librarians? They've turned into mechanical monsters! Negus Vanvaeck probably decided that the library's recordings are nothing but electronic toys, and now these robots are dispensing death and chaos instead of literature! It even looks like they started quoting philosophers – but only those who spoke of the end of the world!

This threat must be eliminated before they start holding their own literature parties, complete with biomass sandwiches!

Oh, so you have done it? Excellent! We have unfettered access to the library's resources again! The problem is, one of the destroyed robots managed to record its memoirs, sort of like "How I became a killer librarian".

I hope these do not end up in Vanvaeck's hands, or we're going to end up with a horror genre bestseller! Continuing the studies in the Informatorium brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Return 12 stolen regular data devices, and 1 extra important one.

The gangs of heretics have overrun the streets of our cities! Why are Negus Shuponu and his munephs turning a blind eye to this?

The ones most dangerous right now are the Blood Heretics who worship Yasskul Bathory, the notorious "Bloody Countess"... She was once murdered in her manor, but now, she has been resurrected again.

Her cult accepts only the most dissolute girls – and the most brainless lads who are ready to throw all their money away for streams with their participation... Perhaps you have heard about Sarbaz Simp and Semer Waifu? Well, and now these "simps" and "waifus" are attacking our "Library" on Bathory's orders, trying to steal certain information... Too early to let you know what it is, though.

Return the stolen data to us immediately, !
I hope Bathory's not going to get the information she seeks from us! Otherwise a scandal will be unavoidable... and the Negus Council is already looking askance at us!

Well, it's written here about how to get into the third level of the catacombs... You will probably as me what catacombs am I talking about? There's no need at all for you know this – forget about it! Or you might end up becoming like Sarbaz Simp... or even Semer Waifu! A disgrace!
Return 12 stolen regular data devices, and 1 extra important one.

Bathory's servants! These strange creatures that sacrifice their time and resources on the altar of Penayeter platforms! Their cult worships women who show their nude bodies – this is not just absurd, this is a new scientific phenomenon!

We need to eliminate these "worshippers" before they start influencing our society in a negative way. And these girls? They're only eager to ditch all of their clothes!

They are now stealing data from our informatoria, trying to find the knowledge their mistress is seeking. We cannot allow this to happen.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Question 5 members of Sar-Iram's noble families about the events before the plague.

Oh, I'm so happy that I ended up here, as an apprentice to Negus Menes himself! Else I might've been stuck in Nezebgrad writing another boring article "On the advantages of Yasker's authority!"

Well, then... we want to collect information about the years right before the plague... when the old rule, the reign of the Despots, fell... Why did it happen? And what did Tep... and Nefer Ur... have to do with that?

I've gathered the data on the heads of the families that dwelled in Sar-Iram at the time... Why don't we ask them personally?

, we need the representatives of the Khadmon, Atzilut'h, Briya, Yetzira and Ashiya families!
Were you able to question all of them? It's not like finding them is too difficult!

Ah well, this... is very interesting. Alright, so what have we learned? Tep, the leader of the Zem nation's psionicists, and Ur, the leader of the Zem nation's mechanics, joined forces and deposed Hickut's last Despot who bore the name Peraach. Peraach and his associates – Bathory and the other priests – were defeated in the end, the ruler was killed, and his body was buried someplace. The survivors eventually became those we call the Heretics now... Curious, isn't it?

h: Can you tell me of how the Despots' reign fell?

t: The secret of happiness is simple: be surrounded with love... and maybe a couple of sinister mysteries!
Question 5 members of Sar-Iram's noble families about the events before the plague.

Ah, my deardarling mentee!

I have a task for you – and it's not going to be boring, I promise! We need to learn of what exactly was happening in Sar-Iram before the plague decided to throw a party here!

So visit the noble families and ask them about the events of yore. Don't forget to record their memories to data storage! And don't be afraid of asking provocative questions – some of them might actually be willing to divulge a dirty secret or two.

After all, the more rumors swirl around, the more exciting our job gets!

Perfect! Have you  collected the memories of the noble families? I wonder how many of them were trying to gloss over their "imperfections"! I hope you've not failed to write down their names. What if someone decides to stage a "performance" in court?

Now, we have the actual chronicle of the events before the plague. Maybe we will even be able to write a bestselling novel of how the rich and famous were dealing with the apocalypse! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: Head of the noble family Atzilut'h

t: Find the reasons for Negus Menes' despondency
Welcome! I trust you want to test the new service – "finding a rutess for every cheni"?
Try finding information about Nomarkh Miu in the Jeb-net.
Hello, it's you, ! I should have guessed! Come on! If it isn't fate... what is it?
Ask Semer Shereda about the events, escort her home.
Alright, we're home... But there's zombies all around! Like, totally creepy! Where'd everyone go, ?
Help the Khadmon family with recovering their mansion by completing 5 quests.
Excellent, ! Everyone is here now... The one problem that remains is dealing with Yasskul Bathory who has managed to infiltrate our family's treasury...
Destroy 12 zombies and close 4 doors by using internal levers.

! Uuuuurgh...

The heretics came! Opened doors! Released zombies!

Now zombies are all around! Doors must be closed!

Levers! Two are here, and two up there...

Pull lever! Close door!

Kill zombies! Then I carry them back...

. Uuuuurgh...

Heretics released zombies!

Now zombies are everywhere outside! Doors must close!

Three more in the tombs! Seven doors in total!

Pull lever! Close doors!

Kill zombies! Kill robots! Then I carry zombies back, and mechanisms to junkyard...

. Good. There are seven tombs.

Zombies lay in each. They have to lay further...

Aggressive Zombies? They become real predators, with sharp teeth and even sharper outlook on the politics of the modern day. We must solve this problem immediately, before they become self-aware and start holding their own ZombElections!

Don't forget to bring your tools of science along – perhaps we will be able to extract some sort of information on the decay of their intellect!

Have you got rid of these aggressive undead? Excellent! We can now conduct experiments on their behavior in stressful conditions. Though... I think their behavior has been studied well enough in practice. I hope they do not garner any more "aggressive' followers! Science brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Well, have you dealt with these combat turrets? Excellent! We can now study their control systems and learn how exactly the cultists were able to set them up such aggressive programming in them. This will help us in the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t:
We're having a serious problem with the aggressive Mechanoids here!

These constructs are serving the cultists, and they are ready to execute any kind of Order — even one that entails the annihilation of any living things nearby. I want to learn what kind of algorithm is making them fight so fearlessly. It could be that they have been programmed for "maximum aggression", or they simply don't know the word "NO".

Have you dealt with these mechanoid monsters? Excellent! I can now analyze their code and learn how exactly they were to set up for such an aggressive programming. This is important for the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Destroy 12 Undead creatures in the Khadmons' mansion.

Zombies in the Khadmons' tomb? Oh, this is just classic!

Looks like the family has started a party where the living trade bodies with the dead! Their macabre jokes and black humor have led to the dead starting to feel right at home in their, well, home. But fear not: we have special treatments against zombies, and some scientific magic, too! Make sure you do not fall under their charms, or they might persuade you to stay at their "party"!

Have you crashed this zombie party? Perfect! Problem is, one of the zombies has managed to record his memoirs to an old Jeb-drive. We may now end up in the possession of the weirdest album in the world! I hope it doesn't become a hit among the dead... More importantly, with the streets calm once again, we're getting closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Collect 25 mycelium essences inside the tombs.

Ah, my little grandkid's brought someone in... All she wants is wiggle her butt around!

Alright, you might do well enough, ! In short, this is how we roll: the guest either goes into the cauldron, or does some work around here. I need the essences of the mycelium that only grows upon the dead, down in the tombs...

See, I'm working in the institute, studying the issues of nutrition. The Zem aren't all that keen on regular food − it doesn't do all that much good to the dead body pumped full of protoblood, other elements are required. So I'm working on developing a new concentrate, and mycology is the most promising direction here.

Enough yakking! Get me the essences, or I'll use you for the mushroom fertilizer!
Where's my essence? All the mushrooms grow in the tombs!
Oh, thank you, dear guest − it means you will keep on living! For the moment...
Collect 25 mycelium essences in the tombs.

Greetings to you, my brave adventurer boygirl! We got a unique opportunity here: we want to learn whether the Arisen can be fed with something a little more exquisite than processed human brains.

You will have to collect mycelium essences down in the tombs. I hope you're not averse to digging through rotting carcasses a little? Don't forget to procure a good solid mask: the smell might be... not too pleasant, so to say. But who knows? You might start a new gastronomic trend for the dead, after all!

Excellent! Have you collected the mycelium essences? I hope they're not smelling as horrible as they look! We can now conduct some experiments and learn whether the Arisen will benefit from the "Mushroom delicacy".

If all goes well, we might create a new trend in the world of the undead! And if it does not... at least we can always use them as the fertilizer for our plants! And, of course, another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
These miscreants have released the zombies, and gone down underground themselves!

Oh, little explosive thingies! My darlings! Now we'll show 'em! But don't trust my sis too much, she just loves torture! If she lures you there − well, it's been nice knowin' ya! I'm not coming anywhere near her without a cannon at hand.

Here's a few Sparkbooms − I hope they come handy...

Hey, you! Yes, it's you I'm talking to!

We have a little problem with "the wonders of pyrotechnics", and we are in need of your daring. We need to collect the bombs from the tombs of the Khadmon family. Don't you worry, they won't explode on touch... at least I hope so! This task requires daring, and more than a little skill of handling dangerous items.

So don't forget to check each bomb for "surprises" − there might be something interesting there! And if you're lucky, you might find a few shocking revelations about the dead denizens of this place.

Bravo! Have you  assembled the bombs? I hope none of them went off while in your hands! Now, we can conduct a number of experiments and learn the efficiency of our "explosive toys" when employed in scientific research.

If all goes to plan, we will be able to create a whole new series of shows about blowing up ancient legends! This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Rescue Yasskul Gyasi, Semer Olufemi and Nomarkh Funsani, bringing them back to the mansion.

So, only the granny and the lil' brother remain in the mansion! My parents seem to be stuck in the tombs, and my uncle, too!

Don't be surprised: big families are a rarity for us, the Arisen. Few got the luck of having all their relatives resurrected in time! We were burying each other during the Plague − luckily, we are embalmers after all! So we got resurrected all together, too!

But it would have been a shame to lose them all now, !

Is everyone here?! Excellent! I did think for a moment that some got eaten by zombies! But as it stands, everyone's alive, and even unharmed, it seems... It's a pity, 'cause I have plenty of spare parts anyway.
When one has a sinister hobby like this, the daily routines don't scare anymore!
Open the door to the treasury and move to the first floor of the catacombs.

The treasury of the Khadmon family! , can you think of the valuables that have been accumulated here over the centuries, especially since no one has ever managed to loot it? To enter the numerous levels of our catacombs, we need special keys − and luckily, I have the key to the first level with me!

But it looks like the heretics have managed to whisk away the keys to the second and third floors! Alright, we sort it out as we go. First, we need to learn the code... We'll have to ask my parents for it. Each of them should know their own part, in theory!
Have you managed to learn the code?
Looks like the code is correct. Now we set off into the catacombs beneath the tomb. They are divided into three levels, but we will only be able to access the first one initially...

You know, when I was young, life was full of exciting adventure... and eccentric entertainment. I remember how we held a fest for the autumn moon festivities, once – with real ghost and culinary extravagance that would have made even the bravest soul shiver in fear.

The Jeb-Flash drive that I gave you contains records about my "friends" – from zombies to vampires. And of course, don't forget about that unfortunate evening with Funsani and his experiments with explosives. It was all good fun – right until he decided to start fireworks in our garden. Oh, we were laughing so hard when the panicked neighbors fled their house!

And, of course, my darling Olufemi! She always knew how to add a little "spice" to our lives. I remember the time when she decided to give me a surprise birthday present, and invited all my "friends" from afterlife. The party was astounding! I remember to this day how a skeleton was trying to play piano – that was something else!

So, my dear frienddarling girl, if you're ready to delve into the world of darkness and insanity... just open the Jeb-Flash drive, and be ready for crazy adventure. I hope your nerves are all right – otherwise, you'd be better off keeping distance from our family!
h: Can you tell me something new of the era when the Despots' reign fell?

t: The first part of the code is 100 to the power of 0!
h: Tell me the first part of the code for accessing the catacombs!

t: Here, we've found it, but don't lose it anymore!
h: I've lost the key to the first level!

t: Deal with the issue of Yasskul Bathory and rescue Nomarkh Miu.
Have you managed to find Nomarkh Miu?

Ahh, dear friends! How can I express my gratitude? Semer Shereda could become my disciple... and you, ... I'm giving my greatest work, the history of Tep that he revealed to me in person, to you... You will find it here, on the Xadagan allod, in the information terminals! Yes, it was me who set them up and enabled broadcasting... The Arisen must learn the truth and make their own personal choices...
Input the code to be teleported to the treasury... or a different place.
Input the code to be teleported to the treasury... or a different place.
Input the code to be teleported to the treasury... or a different place.

h: Use the previously input old code

t: So, here we are! It's cold and dank here! Just the way I like it! These are the old Xadaganian foundations, connected to our ancient catacombs... But it looks like the heretics just went the straight way...
Reach Peraach's tomb and destroy three of Yasskul Bathory's servants along the way.
Bathory binds her servants to her with the power of sex... An interesting way of reinforcing their loyalty!
We are very close now... Literally just one step remains, !
Stop Peraach from being resurrected or kill him, also eradicate Yasskul Bathory and her adherents.
Bravo! He's now going to stay here for another two and a half thousand years! As for Nomarkh Miu, she was somewhere around here. Find her, take her with you and go back to the Library!
Talk to Negus Menes and learn how this all is going to end.

Was I able to understand who Tep was? I think I have... After all, we should ask ourselves: how are we different from Tep? We have taken so much from Nihaz, and the lures of Darkness have been enticing us just as they have him... All of your recent deeds, when you put your goals above the measure of virtue in achieving them... are they really that different from Tep's, ?

The many-faced Darkness − Hirkalla, Baphomet, the Dark Maidens are all just parts of it. You will soon witness another visage of Darkness, with its own will and aspirations.

Farewell, !

h: What's going to happen with you?

t: Go to XAES to learn why the city is having electrical blackouts.

Didn't Negus Kambizet guarantee uninterrupted supply of energy for me?!

But no, we're having blackouts like every half hour!

All right, this is going to be your first real task, : go to him, learn what the problem is about, solve it, and then get his signature for your access form to the Wireframe project... The electronic signature, of course!
You're not in a real hurry! Settle all your issues, and then come back to me.
I'm glad, exceedingly glad to see you! Something weird is going on... We have a clear surplus of energy, but where is it going? It's a big question. One that I hope to have answered, with your help.
Talk to Negus Kambizet, complete his tasks and those given by his employees, then report readiness to him.

, I can assure you − the issue is not with our station! With the new experimental fuel based on Ambrosia, we could power two cities like Sar-Iram, and all the extant projects as well. That, of course, if the load is within parameters, which might not be the case.

Let's get to the bottom of this!
How are my tasks progressing, do you have a lot of work remaining?
Well then, let us try and conduct a little experiment!

Yes, it's all because of spillage, , I'm telling you! I've seen a stream of energy jet from a pipe, recently! Our grids are really lousy, since not only the load is high, but all kinds of critters are eating through them.

Anyway, take a huge roll of blue duct tape, go and plug all the holes! It'll make our life that much easier! Just be sure to take the blue one − it's more durable!
The spillage spots won't fix themselves!
Well, so the power output in the grid jumped by 146% at once! I was right! Now we pray that no one peels off the duct tape!
Eliminate 5 spillage spots on the mana pipeline.
I've seen huge rolls of blue duct tape in the storage, so we'll be able to deal with all of the spillage! And that means that another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

The robots have revolted! Run for your lives!

No, I'm serious, , we're having a real problem with these viruses here. The last worm pierced the firewall and infected all the old Mender Robots! Now they've caused a real massacre here instead of screwing the nuts on and off! And what have we here? Not even a single muneph!

Eradicate the mad robots, please!
Robots want to kill all people! I've warned about that!

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Obtain 10 biological samples from Black Dragons.

I used to work on the HAES in Nezebgrad once, and now I work here on XAES. And the difference is not just about that one letter, .

Out there, the worst thing that can happen are mutated rats and crows. Here, on XAES, the mana energy has attracted dragons! We have a suspicion that in time, they, too, would mutate and increase in size! Imagine the sight!

To avoid a nasty surprise like this, we need to monitor the events! Come and fetch me some samples of dragon flesh!
A dragon the size of a Great Dragon — just imagine!
Well, that'll go in for analysis, but it seems there's nothing new... which is good!
Obtain 12 biological samples from Black Dragons.

In order to monitor the background radiation from the manastation's discharge, we need to collect biological samples from black dragons again. These creatures are exceedingly important for our studie, because their health is directly cnonnected to the condition of the whole local ecosystem. Don't forget that Black Dragons may be quite aggressive, so be cautious and prepared for resistance. You will also be able to tell whether they're really growing with each week.
The lab folks report that they've found nothing novel or suspicious. Well, excellent − the mana station will keep on working, and this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Check 8 employees and expose Tep's hidden spies.
Hey, Tep! I rocked your pyramid! I saw your mama at the brothel!
Did that help? Didn't I tell you! That always works! A 100% efficient method!
Check 8 employees and expose Tep's hidden spies.

Tep and his fanatical followers keep harming us. They infiltrate every institution of the city, becoming "sleeper agents", and apprehending them is a difficult task. We need to check all of Mana Station's employees meticulously so that those who might be working for Tep are weeded out. Pay attention to their behavior and the way they interact with colleagues: spies are often acting suspiciously. I'm sure you will be able to identify them among regular workers − more so since you already have a solid method to rely on...
Sure! All of our shift was laughing!
h: Have you heard the new anecdote about Tep and the goat?

t: Eliminate Yaver Arteia and 12 Path of Ice Heretics.

Time to eliminate the cultists of cold that are using the mana station's energy to mine Zem-coins. Yeah, sure is a genius idea! They think that freezing their own brains solid will make Zem-coins come rolling to them.

Let's show them that cold is not just about money, but about getting their hides chilled! Be ready to make them white hot! We have anything that might come handy, from heaters to hot tea − just don't get us frozen with their "genius ideas" while you're at it.

And don't forget that they might use their "super powers" to stop us. But we know for sure that true power is not in Jeb cash, but in quick wits!

The cultists of ice have been dealt with! But don't you think they're just going to vanish. They're already making new plans for mining Zem-coins out of thin air. And we're still stuck with the Wireframe project, which is getting more and more complicated.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Eliminate 12 Nezebgrad clerks while disguised as Tep's agent.

We are facing the direst threat that might end up completely paralyzing our efforts. And no, this is not about gangs, cultists or hacked robots. I am talking about clerks! The officials from Nezebgrad who arrived on an inspection visit.

If they start trudging through our documentation, all of our work will be completely stalled.

I'm afraid only one course of action remains: kill them all!

Of course, this has to be done in a surreptitious way. For instance, a crazy fanatic of Tep might do the deed, right? Why not...

Take these rags, disguise yourself and send the clerks to meet the Servant of Tensess. They have only a little Mirra, so we're not going to see them for a while. They're now on the shore near the Mana Station, surveying the area.
Eliminate Semer Chibal and 10 biker girls.

Now we need to deal with the gang of biker women and their automobile-riding leader. The bikers are assured that speed trumps all.

Well, it's like they don't understand that being slow and smart is better sometimes.

Arm yourself with whatever you fancy, and let's show them that speed is now always the answer!

The bikers got what they deserved! But don't you think they're just going to ride off into the sunset. They're already mustering their gang for renewed vengeance. And we will keep delving into our Wireframe project, which is clearly not going to become less complicated.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Take part in testing the experimental reactor, following instructions from Negus Kambizet.
The most important thing is acting decisively and making no mistakes!
Take part in testing the experimental reactor, following instructions from Negus Kambizet.

The reactor, and the XAES as a whole, are a crucial part of the city's infrastructure, so they need to be kept operational at all times. And the reactor directly influences the progress of the Wireframe project, making its completion closer.

Nomarkh Khey is writing to you:

"Hello, !

I have another problem here - and you, my deardarling friend, have already shown yourself as a manwoman well capable of solving any kind of issues, no matter how many are there. If you step up to my call, I promise you won't regret it!"
Yeah, preparing for the gig is not that easy!
Looks like everything's ready... Shall we try hooking up to the grid?
Remove 10 crates of aluminum cucumbers and 7 trash bins from the stage.
Excellent − the stage must be vacant so we have enough room to rock out! Out with the trash, down with the Empire!
